name: split-clock
title: Split Clock
summary: Shows the time, the day and the date in the Split panel when no song plays.
description: The right panel of the Split main menu shows the time, the day of the week and the date when there is no current song. When a song starts, the panel shows the cover and the song again.
details: The time changes at each new minute.
The time obeys Settings > Date & Time > Time (12-hour or 24-hour).
The names of the day and the month use the language of the iPod.
A paused song stays in the panel. The clock shows when there is no current song.
requires: The Split layout (iPod Appearance > Layout: Split or Switch on iPod).
notes: With the Stock layout, the patch has no effect.
Set the date and the time on the iPod in Settings > Date & Time.
This patch is not tested on a real iPod.
